summary.scope: Direct and centered rational pullbacks with rational scale and variable powers 1–5. No match means no match in this snapshot under these transformations; it does not exclude a Calabi–Yau interpretation. A period or operator match does not identify a deformation family. CYDB topological numbers are reported source data, not inferred invariants of the Fano section.
